$comment: Summa operational failure boundaries. Expected outcomes (a server refusal, a request with no answer, an unknown outcome) remain typed application replies shown as ordinary errors and are not Aegis faults. See src/Summa.Web.Application/Boundary.fs.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (work backlog and hub pages)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (BacklogWire.handle, HubWire.handle). A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on is MESSAGE_INVALID. Programming defects (for example an event name index.html sends that the engine does not know) keep Aegis fail-loud semantics and surface as a Limen bridge error.

boundaries.name: Summa server response decoding
boundaries.$comment: A 2xx reply from tools/ros_server.mjs or tools/ros_hub_server.mjs whose body is not the agreed shape (or would not decode) is externally sourced data the engine cannot trust; it is captured and presented through Forma's fault component, and the page keeps its previous state.

boundaries.name: Limen files and transfer packs
boundaries.$comment: An upload or file release the kernel did not execute (not negotiated, rejected, invalid request, unknown file) is a capability fault. Upload refusals and unknown outcomes reported by the server remain typed replies.

boundaries.name: Browser HTTP and file effects
boundaries.$comment: Execution occurs browser-side (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, file pickers). Observed outcomes cross the Limen protocol as explicit typed outcomes; this declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript.

boundaries.name: Node work-protocol servers
boundaries.$comment: The copied Node-era ROS servers (QDI-071) answer HTTP with JSON errors; they are outside the .NET tier and are not Aegis-guarded. Their refusals reach the engine as typed replies.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Summa does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured; in the browser the standard-error sink writes to the console.
